attributes.action: Ask FA to interview Pep Guardiola to ascertain if he will become England Manager
attributes.additional_details:
For a national coach to publicly question the DNA of English football makes Mr Tuchel position untenable. The relationship between player and manager can not be repaired. He is the manager who was brought in after Gareth to change that. The fault must ultimately sit with Mr Tuchel. 
Given that the best manager in the world is currently out of work. I seek that the government ask the FA, to formally approach Pep Guardiola about becoming the next England manager to lead us to Euro 2028.
attributes.background: Englands exit from the World Cup has hurt a full nation. Questions are being asked at every level as to what happened in the last 35 minutes of the match.  Was it the players or was it the manager. The comments from our manager about it being in our DNA suggests the end of this tenure.
